Rune

Variation 10, and Ply grown up. Same data as ios-2, same charts, same Play. What changed is what the marks are made of. On the ring the four kinds are now four shapes: sleep is one thick band with a moon at its start, a meal is a plate as wide as its calories, a move is a tick that becomes a drawn check, a workout is a bar as wide as its minutes. Add opens on three equal tiles — camera, voice, text — and Send does not exist until there is something to send. The plate donut carries a glyph on each arc and puts every number in a legend row underneath, off the arcs, with the target rails left exactly as they were.

The read
Twenty-four characters again, so the day is still one turn of the clock and the ring stays. What is new is in the digits: six of them, 9 9 5 6 9 5, and they add to 43 — the exercise minutes already on file for today. Nine comes three times, and nine is the calories a gram of fat carries, so the donut is three arcs and fat is the one that has to be drawn honestly. Five comes twice: five moves in a day, two of them closed. And the letters R, U, N, E are all in there — a rune is a mark whose shape carries its meaning, which is the entire change on this page. Two capital U's, at 10 and at the very end, and a U is a bowl seen from the side: the meals ply is plates. Ten capitals, eight lowercase, six digits — loud, quiet, counted.
Mood
Shape before colour. Turn the colour off and the day still reads.
Accent
One indigo still, #4c46a6 on the cream and #a49dee on the navy, and it is still only the current value: the now hand, the mark you tapped, the run against the goal, the projection. The donut gets three steps of that one family — #332e78 at 11.4:1 for protein, #4c46a6 at 7.1:1 for carbs, #7a74c6 at 3.3:1 for fat, which carries a glyph and never a word. Lime is down to one control on the whole page: the Send that appears when a sentence exists. The Play button and the scan line gave theirs up.
Type
Ply's rungs, kept: 34 for the number, 11 for the caption, 13 a row title, 21 a screen heading, 15 on a meal name. The one size below the ladder is the 10 px second line in the ring legend and on a tile, and it says what the shape is — a caption of a caption, and the only place on the page that needs one.
Density
Full-bleed charts on a 364 px frame, as before. Add is three columns of equal width with a square drawing at the top of each, so no way in is bigger than the others; the camera, the mic and the field then take the whole stage in turn.
Cards
A chart is still not a card, and every target mark is still drawn inside its own track with the fill exactly as tall as the track. The ring gains one rule: a ply that carries marks gets a hairline to stand on, and a ply that carries a fill gets a track. That is why sleep and the workout sit in tracks and the plates and the ticks sit on rails.
Motion
One easing, cubic-bezier(.22, 1, .36, 1), and the same family that halves the way 24 does: 120 / 240 / 480 / 960 ms. New here: the check on the ring draws itself in 480 ms, the same stroke as the chip's; a plate that lands pops once at 480; and swapping a tile for its stage takes no time at all, because a door should not animate.
The idea
Four kinds, four shapes, no legend needed. A band, a plate, a tick, a bar: the size of each says how much and the shape says which, so the ring survives being printed in grey. The legend is then not a key but a caption — it names the shape and shows the drawing — and the four drawings, the three tiles and the three macros are ten generated spot illustrations in the same flat ink-on-cream hand, doing the work a 9 px label used to do badly.
01

The day, one ring

Twenty-four hours, four kinds, four shapes. Sleep is one thick band on the outside with a moon at the hour it started. Each meal is a plate on the next rail in, as wide as its calories, and the biggest plate of the day holds the utensils. Each move is a short tick that becomes a drawn check the moment it closes. The workout is a bar on the inside whose width is its minutes, with a dumbbell on it. The indigo hand is now, and indigo is also the only thing that marks what you tapped. Tap any shape and the card under the ring says what it was; tick a move chip and its tick turns into a check, the count in the middle goes up, today's bar grows and the flame catches when the day closes.

Why four shapes and not four colours

the reading

A ring tells you when, and when is the whole argument: the walk after the largest meal only counts if it followed the largest meal. But four arcs of the same width in four steps of one grey are four of the same thing, and the eye has to go to the legend to find out which. A band, a plate, a tick and a bar are four different things before any colour is applied — and the size of each is its own number, so the 623 kcal plate is visibly the plate the walk belongs to.

02

Add, played

Add opens on three tiles of the same size: camera, voice, text, a drawing each and one line each. Tap one and the stage becomes that way in — the viewfinder with its framing brackets, the mic, or the field — with the other two a tap away underneath. There is no Send until there is something to send, and when it arrives it is the only lime on the page. Then press Play: the sheet runs the whole sequence at the speed the app will run it. Text types itself and Send lights. Voice draws a waveform and the transcript lands word by word. One photo gets the scan line, then the callouts one at a time, then the meal card rising with the numbers counting up. Several photos are read in turn, with a tick on each thumbnail. All four end at the same receipt — and at the receipt the meal lands on the ring in section 01 as a new arc, and the calorie number in section 03 moves with it.

03

The plate, as a donut

One donut, three arcs, the day's calories in the middle at 34 px. The arcs are the energy each macro contributed, not its grams, because the ring has to add to the number in the middle or it is lying. Nothing is written on an arc: each one carries its own glyph knocked out of the fill — a fish, a stalk of wheat, a droplet — and the grams and the calories go in the legend row under the donut, with the drawing beside them. Each macro is one step of the accent family. Under that, the target rails, exactly as they were: the fill is as tall as its track and the target mark is drawn inside it.

Why energy and not grams

the donut's rule

Protein and carbohydrate carry 4 kcal a gram, fat carries 9. A donut split by grams would give fat a third of the ring while it supplies half the energy, and the number in the middle would not follow from the arcs around it. So the arcs are kcal and the grams are on the rails underneath, where a target belongs.

04

The expectation, at full width

The hero of Today. Two measured draws, the goal band as a green wash rather than a hatch, the projection dotted to the horizon and the landing number at 34 px right under it. Switch a food rule or a habit and the line re-aims, the band widens or tightens and the number moves — the arithmetic is lib/projection.ts run in the browser: grade-weighted effect × adherence × min(1, horizon ÷ the paper's own duration), summed, clamped by MAX_CHANGE. Drag across the plot and the tooltip follows your finger.

The markers, as small multiples

The sparkline the old row squeezed into 55 px gets a panel of its own: six markers, two to a row, each with its number at 34 px, its own trace, the goal band as a dashed rule across it, and the ruler underneath with the value's mark drawn inside the track. What each tile carries

one component

The name and its unit at 11 px, the current value at 34 px, six to twelve readings as a trace with the last one marked in indigo, the optimal band as a dashed green rule across the trace, and the ruler: the band as a green fill inside the track, the value as a 2 px mark inside the same track. The ruler's ends are labelled, so the tile never needs an axis.

08

Where the numbers and the drawings come from

Data. The same file as ios-2.html and the other seven variations: 52 markers with a value, 7 off, TPO 320 IU/mL against normal 0–34, vitamin D 19 ng/mL against 40–60, ferritin 22 ng/mL, LDL 118 mg/dL against the 70–100 goal band, the Aug 1 2026 draw, a 6-day streak with 18 as the best run, three meals on Saturday Sep 5 totalling 1 497 kcal est. and 93 / 93 / 84 g, steps 10 935 against a 90-day mean of 11 062, exercise 43 min against 49, three strength sessions on file for the week. The projection is lib/projection.ts run in the browser on the seeded interventions: effect × grade weight (A and B 1, C 0.5, D and E 0) × adherence × min(1, horizon ÷ the paper's own duration), summed, clamped by MAX_CHANGE.ldl_cholesterol = 50, with the band from GRADE_SPREAD. Adherence is the figure on each Plan row: psyllium 86 %, oats 64 %, olive oil 85 %, the walk 57 %, resistance 33 %, plant sterols 71 % if it were adopted. The two dated draws on file are 168 mg/dL on Dec 9 2025 and 131 on Aug 1 2026; 118 is the Sep 1 2026 panel.

The hours. The ring places what is already on file: sleep 23:10 → 06:40 with one break at 03:20, meals at 08:15, 13:05 and 19:30, the selenium at 08:20, the steps total landing at 11:32, the post-meal walk due at 13:40, the resistance session 18:00 → 18:45. Nothing on the ring is invented; it is the same day the list shows, drawn round.

The drawings

ten, generated

Ten flat spot illustrations, one hand throughout: ink on cream with the indigo used once each. Four name the kinds in the ring legend — a moon on a pillow, a plate with the fork and knife crossed, two footprints with a check, a dumbbell. Three head the Add tiles — a phone over a plate, a microphone, a keyboard. Three sit in the donut legend — a fish, a stalk of wheat, a droplet from a jug. Each was made at square size, cut to 256 px and inlined as base64, so this page is still one file. The photographs are the same seven as the other variations, and in the app the picture is always the owner's own.
